summary: This Form 6-K filed by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited on May 26, 2026 contains an English translation of notes to consolidated and unconsolidated financial statements. The filing lists 154 consolidated subsidiaries, 10 equity-method associates, and policy details on property, goodwill, and intangible assets under IFRS. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic financial report from a foreign private issuer, providing standard accounting disclosures without any event-driven corporate action.
